title: Soft Puffed Pita Bread
summary: A simple olive oil dough is kneaded, risen, rolled into even 5 mm rounds and baked for a few minutes on a preheated tray until fully puffed.
equipment: large bowl or stand mixer with dough hook
2 large baking trays or a baking steel

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Stir the flour, yeast, sugar and salt together, add the water and oil and knead 8-10 minutes by hand, or 5 minutes in a mixer, until smooth and springy.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 1-1.5 hours until doubled.

steps.title: Divide
steps.text: Knock back and cut into 8 pieces of about 105 g. Shape into tight balls, cover and rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the tray
steps.text: Heat an upturned baking tray or steel on the lowest shelf at 250 °C (230 °C fan) for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll each ball into a 16-17 cm round about 5 mm thick, keeping the thickness even. Keep covered.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 2-3 at a time for 3-4 minutes until fully puffed and pale gold in patches. Wrap at once in a tea towel and serve warm with hummus.

tips: An even thickness is what makes pita puff; thin spots tear and thick spots stay flat.
Do not overbake: pale pita stays soft, golden pita turns crisp.
Keep the rolled rounds covered so the surface does not dry and stop them puffing.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature and eat within 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Refresh in a hot oven for a few minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
